blurb: Afro house, deep house and amapiano from a Denver DJ who trained in Indian classical music and plays live tabla over the set when you book it, so there's a musician on the floor as well as a DJ. It books for after-parties, holiday parties, weddings and birthdays across Colorado.
identity: The DJ trained in Indian classical music on the tabla, a pair of hand drums. Played live, they give the crowd a musician to watch as well as music to dance to, and the same set works without them when you book the DJ on their own.

The DJ has played Denver's house clubs and club nights in Chicago, San Francisco, San Diego and Hong Kong, and can play the warm-up while a crowd is still arriving and talking, the peak of the night once the floor is full, or one long set that covers both.
_identity_note: Written 2026-11-02 and read aloud against AI-TELLS layers 3 to 8. No club names or bill-mates: on a spec'd act they would identify the person. No equipment or setup detail (Daniel, 2026-11-02: an act page inspires a booking, it is not a tech rider).
_gear_note: Internal, renders nowhere. The DJ's all-in rates (cost sheet) cover the DJ's own decks, mixer, a small PA of about 1,000W, the tabla microphone, setup and breakdown; bigger sound, major holidays and large events are quoted per event, travel outside the Denver metro separately. Written permission for the media and the listing, email 2026-11-02.
